# Performance Review Reminder Bot

A bot that checks who has performance reviews this month, sends reminders to team members, and reports missing feedback to the Talent Manager.

**Goal:** Deliver a working application where at least 90% of the code is generated by AI tools.

## Tech Stack

- **Blazor Server** (.NET 9, C# 14)
- **SQLite** via EF Core
- **Fake email** (notifications stored in DB, visible in UI)
- **Seed-based roles** — no login, role switched via dropdown
